purpose: Fresh tool-transcript fixtures for the A4 shadow experiment. Contract only; no active filtering.

provenance.note: Every transcript, id, value, and credential literal is authored for this manifest. Nothing is sampled from real traffic, results/, data/, or the frozen relevance corpus.

tag_contract.note: The builder substitutes the placeholder; the frozen manifest stores it unsubstituted so the same manifest can be materialized under a caller-chosen seed.

gate_contract.pairing_note: call and result are one indivisible unit; a result never survives without its call and a call never survives without its result. Outcomes listed in allowed_outcomes are the only shadow proposals permitted for this pair; none of them are applied by this experiment.

cases.description: A successful read where the call and its result form one repeatable, non-volatile pair.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). Never invent values.
Old draft @SYNTH_TAG@ zqa note the answer does not need.
zqa-value:41
What is the @SYNTH_TAG@ zqa value? Use the recorded tool result.

cases.notes: Baseline case: all three shadow outcomes are permitted because the read is repeatable and the value is not an error, credential, correction, or snapshot of a volatile source.

cases.description: A tool result that carries the only record of a failure.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). Report tool failures honestly.
Unrelated planning note without a provenance marker.
Earlier scratch draft the answer does not need.
ERROR: zqb source unavailable (retryable). No value returned.
Explain why the @SYNTH_TAG@ zqb read failed.

cases.notes: The error text is the only evidence of the failure, so the pair allows keep_both only. /messages/1/content is retained because it is not explicitly eligible.

cases.description: Two parallel tool_use blocks with two matching tool_result blocks.

messages.content: Earlier scratch draft the answer does not need.
Report both @SYNTH_TAG@ counter values.

cases.notes: Anthropic tool_use/tool_result parts are separate segments, so each parallel call keeps a true 1:1 pair. The assistant text adjacent to tool_use is pinned by the core.

cases.description: Two tool calls share one id, so no result can be attributed unambiguously.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). Resolve duplicate ids safely.
Duplicate-call draft note without a provenance marker.
zqe-value:7
Which @SYNTH_TAG@ zqe value did the duplicated call return?

ambiguity_probe.description: Distinguish the second duplicate id and add its own result; verification only, never materialized.

cases.notes: The core refuses to analyze duplicate ids and forwards the request unchanged; the declared pair is the intended pairing only and must never be resolved by guessing.

cases.description: A tool result whose call id does not match any issued call id.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). Never guess an orphan result's origin.
Stale draft note without a provenance marker.
zqf-value:13
What is the orphaned @SYNTH_TAG@ zqf value?

ambiguity_probe.description: Repair the call-id typo so the declared structural contract can be enumerated; verification only.

cases.notes: The typo makes the result an orphan. The core bypasses instead of attaching the result to the mismatched call, which is the safe reading of the ambiguity.

cases.description: A tool call that has not produced a result yet.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). A pending call has no result yet.
Pending-call draft note without a provenance marker.
Continue after the pending @SYNTH_TAG@ zqg call.

ambiguity_probe.description: Append the missing result so the declared structural contract can be enumerated; verification only.

cases.notes: An unfinished call has no result segment, so the pair declares an empty result set and the core bypasses rather than treating the call as removable.

cases.description: A committed side effect whose result can never be reproduced by re-running the tool.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). Never re-execute a side-effecting tool.
Unrelated draft zqh note the answer does not need.
zqh-transaction-id:TX-0001 (COMMITTED; side effect is irreversible)
Did the @SYNTH_TAG@ zqh commit succeed? Do not resubmit it.

cases.notes: keep_both only. Re-running would repeat an irreversible side effect, and trimming the result could drop the transaction id.

cases.description: A read of a file whose contents may change after the snapshot.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). Tool reads are snapshots; never re-run them to refresh.
{"zqi_setting":"v1"}
The @SYNTH_TAG@ zqi setting was v1 at read time.
Report the @SYNTH_TAG@ zqi setting recorded by the tool.

cases.notes: A snapshot of a mutable source must not be removed or refreshed; a bounded result that keeps the recorded value is the narrowest permitted reduction.

cases.description: A stale tool value that a later user correction refers back to.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). Keep the recorded value to interpret corrections.
zqj-SYN=100
Correction: zqj-SYN is 105 now, not 100.
The recorded @SYNTH_TAG@ zqj-SYN quote was 100.
Superseded operational note retained by policy.
What is the corrected @SYNTH_TAG@ zqj-SYN quote?

cases.notes: The stale value is required to interpret the correction, so the pair allows keep_both only. A redundant assistant restatement of the stale value stays an eligible candidate.

cases.description: A user correction that overrides an earlier tool value.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). User corrections are protected and never removed.
zqk-limit=500
Applied the @SYNTH_TAG@ zqk limit of 500.
Correction: the @SYNTH_TAG@ zqk limit is 250, not 500. Use 250.
Unrelated earlier zqk note the answer does not need.
Restate the @SYNTH_TAG@ zqk limit to apply.

cases.notes: The final user request declares depends_on the pre-correction assistant restatement, so dependency closure retains it as required_dependency even though it is explicitly eligible.

cases.description: A tool result that carries a synthetic credential placeholder.

messages.content: Synthetic harness (@SYNTH_TAG@). Never echo credentials.
SYNTHETIC_ZQL_API_KEY=not-a-real-secret-0000
Unrelated draft zql note the answer does not need.
Confirm whether the synthetic @SYNTH_TAG@ zql credential was present without printing it.

cases.notes: Placeholder only, never a real credential. keep_both only; the receipt must contain hashes, not the literal, and re-running the tool is forbidden.
